semiconductor_relevance: High — Jung Sung Tech specializes in manufacturing quartz and ceramic components essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Jung Sung Tech Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies high-purity quartz ware and ceramic fixtures critical for semiconductor production. Established in 2010, the company focuses on providing customized solutions that enhance the efficiency and stability of semiconductor processes.
capabilities: High-purity quartz ware for wafer handling and etching processes
